name: three_bar_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when three consecutive 5-second bars each close in the same direction (close > open for bulls) with both volume and bar range expanding monotonically, it indicates an institutional TWAP or algo order is still actively routing — each successive 5-second slice consumes more liquidity at a wider spread than the previous, signaling the order has not yet completed its fill. Unlike individual FnO stocks where this pattern can reflect a single large order, NIFTY's index composition means three expanding-volume bullish bars reflect aggregate buy-side imbalance from multiple participants simultaneously, making continuation more persistent. The next 15-90 seconds captures the residual 'still-filling' phase before the algorithmic slice completes and the imbalance normalizes.

indicators.name: bar_return_0
indicators.purpose: Current 5-second bar direction — must exceed minimum threshold (0.01%) to exclude doji bars that indicate no order imbalance.

indicators.name: bar_return_1
indicators.purpose: Prior 5-second bar direction — must be same sign as current bar.

indicators.name: bar_return_2
indicators.purpose: 2-bars-ago direction — 3rd consecutive bar confirms persistent order flow, not a brief spike.

indicators.name: vol_expanding
indicators.purpose: Expanding volume across 3 bars (15 seconds) confirms accelerating order routing. NOT scaled from original — the pattern is still 3 bars regardless of bar size. The original was 3 × 1-min; we use 3 × 5s because the same pattern at higher frequency gives earlier entry into the same order-flow event.

indicators.name: range_expanding
indicators.purpose: Expanding bar range across 3 bars confirms widening order imbalance — each bar's price discovery range grows because available liquidity at each new level is thinner. A doji-then-range pattern would suggest stalling; monotonic range expansion confirms continuation.

indicators.name: vol_context_20
indicators.purpose: 20-bar (100-second) rolling average volume as normalization context. Kept short (NOT scaled to original's SMA20 on 1-min = 20 minutes) because NIFTY intraday volume pattern changes rapidly — morning vs afternoon regimes. 100s captures local volume regime without over-smoothing.

buy_ce.confirmation: Signal fires on close of 3rd bullish bar; enter ATM CE on that bar's close (limit order)

buy_pe.confirmation: Signal fires on close of 3rd bearish bar; enter ATM PE on that bar's close (limit order)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5) — if the 3-bar momentum pattern immediately reverses within 15-30 seconds, it indicates the institutional order completed mid-pattern and our entry was at the tail end. A 4-pt stop exits before the full reversal, consistent with typical 15-30s NIFTY retracement range of 2-5 option pts.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts (~12 NIFTY spot pts) — we enter AFTER 3 bars have already moved, so we're capturing the residual continuation, not the full move. 12 spot pts in 30-90 seconds is the median continuation leg from a 3-bar expansion pattern, consistent with NIFTY's 30-90s typical move range of 2-7 option pts. 1:1.5 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: none — original had no VIX filter; three-bar pattern is regime-agnostic
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST; skip first 5 minutes (09:15-09:20) to avoid pre-open noise
filters.trend_filter: none — pure momentum play, no trend alignment required
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — three-bar patterns are visible to many systems; edge survives because entry at 5s is faster than systems operating on 1-min bars

adaptation_notes: Original was 1-min bars on top-30 FnO stocks. Converted to 5-second NIFTY bars, keeping the same 3-bar count (not scaled to 36 bars) because the pattern logic is about the NUMBER of consecutive confirming bars, not a time window — the same institutional order-flow signal exists whether bars are 5s or 1-min. Volume and range expansion thresholds kept relative (monotonic), not absolute. Stops/targets compressed from 0.15%/0.20% (equity) to 4/6 option pts because the 5s NIFTY hold is 15-90s versus original's 5-15 min, and expected moves scale accordingly.
weaknesses: Three 5-second bars = only 15 seconds of data — pattern fires frequently and may have low precision in choppy markets
Expanding range/volume on 5s NIFTY is common during volatile index intraday swings — signal frequency may be too high on high-vol days
No trend filter means trading against strong reversals; consider adding index > VWAP for buy_ce entries
